title: glochidion korthalsii
intro: Glochidion korthalsii, commonly known as the "Borneo Bayur", is a plant species native to Borneo and other parts of Southeast Asia. It is a type of Euphorbiaceae family member, known for its medicinal properties. The plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Glochidion korthalsii include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial effects.
